observations.note: The Fix text says to keep the mark of any row you leave unchanged, but the flagged rows were unchanged rows whose file changed in a later commit, so the prompt should say that a mark is also emptied when the row's file changed after its marking commit.

The step has no git or shell, so it can only unmark the rows the check names, and attempts 3 and 4 each cleared a different batch of marks; the engine should list every stale-marked row at once or drop all marks on a trip back.
One edit was sent with identical old and new text and failed with no change, which cost a turn.
